records.label: A400-01 · Membrane technology — hold H-01
records.status: Technology hold — model shows one candidate
records.detail: Three configurations are on record: VSEP i84 vibratory-shear (REP-001 V1.1, the MEB-007 model and the 3D geometry — eight 84-inch packs), a standalone spiral-wound TFF reference case (REP-007: 238 Synder elements, 981 m², rejected as procurement basis) and a hybrid bulk mechanical separation + TFF polishing (REP-017, provisional). MAT-002 M-029 (ceramic) and CAL-010 (PES/PVDF hollow fibre) assume different membranes again. D-A400-01 approves none and keeps the model class generic; the modelled VSEP is a candidate, not a selection.
records.action: Run the H-01 bench program on actual A-300 quench cake at pH 2–4 (flux, c_max, fouling), select the configuration, then re-issue FEED-PE-MEB-007 (V18) on the DBM V2.0 basis and re-tag the model package accordingly.

records.label: A400-02 · Graphite and wash-water basis
records.status: Basis withdrawn — 8× spread in wash water
records.detail: MEB-007 runs on 50 kg/h graphite (CAL-010 is a 10 kg pilot batch) against the DBM V2.0 design rate of 63.5 kg/h; wash water is 887.5 kg/kg graphite as equivalent diavolumes (MEB-007), 7,088 kg/kg in the pilot (CAL-010) and 7,691 kg/kg in the cost model (REP-017). REP-036 shows the pilot excess is cycle geometry and surface buffer, not chemistry. D-A400-01 withdrew flux (72 / 78 LMH), diavolumes (36.8 / 37.0 / 284), module count (8 / 1), permeate duty and the T-402 / T-403 volumes; the 20 m³ and 98.6 m³ figures are screening or pilot inputs.
records.action: Fix one graphite rate (DBM V2.0 Table 3.3-1) and one wash-water basis from the H-01 bench results; then size TFF-401, T-402, T-403 and the wastewater case with A-1000 / A-2000 (REP-038).

records.label: A400-03 · Wash endpoint and product-release criterion
records.status: Approved endpoints — two targets to reconcile
records.detail: Approved: feed pH 1 from the A-300 acid wash and target pH 5 washed product (D-A400-02, MEB-007; all documents agree); PFD-0400 endpoint "permeate conductivity < 100–200 µS/cm and pH ≈ 5"; REP-001 Table 5 wash-liquor target pH 5.0 ± 0.2, SO₄²⁻ ≤ 1 mg/L, Mn non-detect, conductivity < 10 µS/cm; low-TMP operating philosophy; membrane limits 25 °C at pH < 2 / 50 °C above (polymeric options). The two conductivity targets differ by an order of magnitude and REP-036 shows pH 5 and SO₄ ≤ 1 mg/L are not equivalent once the surface buffer dominates.
records.action: Decide whether pH, conductivity or sulphate is the release criterion, reconcile PFD-0400 with REP-001 and link the result to FEED-QA-SPC-001; carry the chosen endpoint into the LST-007 loops and the C&E matrix.

records.label: A400-04 · Pump duties P-402 / P-403 / P-405
records.detail: P-402 2,838 m³/h and 363.8 kW belong to the standalone-TFF reference case (REP-007), rejected as procurement basis by REP-017; MEB-007 gives 229.5 kW shaft on the 50 / 80 kg/h basis. In MEB-007 P-405 is an RO concentrate pump, whereas the model P-405 is the CIP circulation pump of CIP-401 with tank TK-405 — same tag, different service. D-A400-01 withdrew all three duties.
records.action: Re-derive pump duties from the re-issued MEB-007; resolve the P-405 identity (RO concentrate vs CIP circulation) on PFD-0400 and LST-001 before datasheets.

records.label: A400-05 · Materials of construction
records.status: Ruled — confirm with the H-01 selection
records.detail: D-A400-MOC applies the plant-wide ruling that FEED-PE-MAT-002 governs: T-402 PVDF- or PFA-lined carbon-steel pressure vessel (M-031), TFF-401 PVDF / PP-lined or dual-laminate FRP, P-402 PVDF / ETFE-lined sealless with SiC bearings, T-403 / P-403 HDPE / PP / PVDF / dual-laminate FRP. MDL-001 (vinyl-ester FRP, PVDF pump) is superseded, not deleted. The membrane material itself stays unapproved under H-01 (MAT-002 M-029 ceramic vs polymeric options).
records.action: Issue A-400 datasheets on the MAT-002 base case; confirm the T-402 pressure-vessel duty (pressure-assisted to 60 °C per M-031) against the H-01 configuration before purchase.

records.label: A400-06 · Register and model reconciliation
records.detail: The five LST-001 tags (T-402, TFF-401, T-403, P-402, P-403) are bound to model geometry. The model additionally owns CIP-401 with TK-405 and P-405, the battery limit BL-A400, three containment bunds BND-401 / BND-403 / BND-404 (50.6 / 86.2 / 10.3 m³ retention), two fire points FE-401 / FE-402 and four emergency stations — none with a register identity. Five items named in design notes are absent from PFD-0400, LST-001 and the model: F-402, RO-401, T-404, P-404 and T-405 (the REP-001 permeate-recycle train). CAL-010 tags the package TFF-301.
records.action: Either add the F-402 / RO-401 / T-404 / P-404 / T-405 train to PFD-0400 and the model or remove it from the design notes with the H-01 decision; register CIP-401 / TK-405 / P-405 and BL-A400 on LST-001; assign identities to bunds, fire points and stations or record them as model-side safety assets by decision; align the CAL-010 tag.

records.label: A400-07 · Vents, drains and CIP interfaces
records.detail: The model carries five interface records — IF-A400-T402-VENT, IF-A400-T403-VENT, IF-A400-TFF-VENT, IF-A400-DRAIN, IF-A400-TFF-DRAIN — without register identities or destinations. The permeate bund BND-403 is annotated "acidity and residual oxidizer unverified"; the CIP bund BND-404 is kept separate from process. Vent routing to A-3000 follows the S1 / S2 / S3 segregation ruled under D-A3000-01; the A-400 vents are wet, acidic and may carry residual oxidiser.
records.action: Assign destinations for the five interfaces on PFD-0400 (A-3000 S1 for vents; A-1000 for drains), confirm permeate acidity / oxidiser for the BND-403 basis, and define the CIP chemistry and spent-liquor route before the containment review.
